name: Hibi Nazako
source:
Hibi is a very shy person who always has trouble expressing herself to someone she doesn't know.
[spoiler]When she meets Toma for the first time, she immediately tries to avoid him because since then the humans have committed a lot of atrocity to her race.[/spoiler]
translation:
Hibi is a very shy person who always has trouble expressing herself to someone she doesn't know.
[spoiler]When she meets Toma for the first time, she immediately tries to avoid him because since then the humans have committed a lot of atrocity to her race.[/spoiler]
